reports.title: Average Degree Centrality (ADC)
reports.query:
MATCH (n)
WITH count(n) as numNodes
MATCH ()-[r]->()
WITH numNodes, count(r) as numRels
RETURN toFloat(numRels) / numNodes AS ADC

reports.title: Graph Density
reports.query:
MATCH (n)
WITH count(n) as v
MATCH ()-[r]->()
WITH v, count(r) as numRels
RETURN toFloat(numRels) / (v * (v - 1)) as Density

reports.title: Glossary Validation Rate
reports.query:
MATCH (c:Concept)
WITH count(c) as total
MATCH (c:Concept)
WHERE c.glossary_validated = true
RETURN toFloat(count(c)) / total AS GlossaryValidationRate
// Persentase konsep tervalidasi glosarium (Target: Tinggi)

reports.title: Materi Pokok Coverage
reports.query:
MATCH (c:Concept)
WITH count(c) as total
MATCH (c:Concept)
WHERE c.materi_pokok_ref IS NOT NULL AND c.materi_pokok_ref <> ""
RETURN toFloat(count(c)) / total AS MateriPokokCoverage
// Persentase konsep dengan referensi materi pokok (Target: >= 0.80)

reports.title: Description Completeness
reports.query:
MATCH (e) WHERE e:Concept OR e:ConceptTarget
WITH count(e) as total
MATCH (e) WHERE (e:Concept OR e:ConceptTarget)
AND e.description IS NOT NULL AND e.description <> ""
RETURN toFloat(count(e))/total AS DescriptionCompleteness
// Persentase entitas dengan deskripsi (Target: >= 0.90)

reports.title: Typed Relation Ratio
reports.query:
MATCH ()-[r]->()
WITH count(r) as total
MATCH ()-[r:MENDEFINISIKAN|MENYEBABKAN|MEMUNGKINKAN|MENGATUR|BAGIAN_DARI|TERDIRI_DARI|BERGANTUNG_PADA|BERINTERAKSI_DENGAN|BEREAKSI_DENGAN|MENGHASILKAN|MEMPENGARUHI|DIFORMULASIKAN_SEBAGAI|PRASYARAT|MEMPERSIAPKAN]->()
RETURN toFloat(count(r))/total AS TypedRelationRatio
// Proporsi relasi semantik vs struktural

reports.title: Distribusi Node dalam Ontologi
reports.query:
MATCH (n)
RETURN labels(n)[0] AS Label, count(n) AS Jumlah
ORDER BY Jumlah DESC

reports.title: Distribusi Relasi (Edge)
reports.query:
MATCH ()-[r]->()
RETURN type(r) AS TipeRelasi, count(r) AS Jumlah
ORDER BY Jumlah DESC
LIMIT 15

reports.title: Konsep per Subtopic
reports.query:
MATCH (s:Subtopic)-[:HAS_CONCEPT]->(c:Concept)
RETURN s.name AS Subtopic, count(c) AS JumlahKonsep
ORDER BY JumlahKonsep DESC
LIMIT 20

reports.title: Cross-Chapter Relations (PRASYARAT/MEMPERSIAPKAN)
reports.query:
MATCH p=()-[:PRASYARAT|MEMPERSIAPKAN]->()
RETURN p
LIMIT 100

reports.title: Visualisasi Knowledge Graph (Full)
reports.query:
MATCH p=(g:Grade)-[:HAS_CHAPTER]->(ch:Chapter)-[:HAS_SUBTOPIC]->(s:Subtopic)-[:HAS_CONCEPT]->(c:Concept)
RETURN p
LIMIT 200

reports.title: Relasi Semantik (LLM-Extracted)
reports.query:
MATCH p=()-[:MENDEFINISIKAN|MENYEBABKAN|MEMUNGKINKAN|MENGATUR|BAGIAN_DARI|TERDIRI_DARI|BERGANTUNG_PADA|BERINTERAKSI_DENGAN|BEREAKSI_DENGAN|MENGHASILKAN|MEMPENGARUHI|DIFORMULASIKAN_SEBAGAI]->()
RETURN p
LIMIT 150

reports.title: Grade Overview
reports.query:
MATCH (g:Grade)
RETURN g.name AS Grade, g.name AS Name

reports.title: Chapters per Grade
reports.query:
MATCH (g:Grade)-[:HAS_CHAPTER]->(c:Chapter)
RETURN g.name AS Grade, count(c) AS JumlahChapter

reports.title: Chapter Chain (Sequential)
reports.query:
MATCH p=(:Chapter)-[:NEXT_CHAPTER]->(:Chapter)
RETURN p

reports.title: Chapter Summary
reports.query:
MATCH (c:Chapter)
WHERE c.summary IS NOT NULL
RETURN c.name AS Chapter, c.summary AS Summary
ORDER BY c.name

reports.title: Glossary-Validated Concepts
reports.query:
MATCH (c:Concept)
WHERE c.glossary_validated = true
RETURN c.name AS Konsep, c.description AS Deskripsi, c.materi_pokok_ref AS MateriPokok
LIMIT 50

reports.title: Concepts Without Materi Pokok Ref
reports.query:
MATCH (c:Concept)
WHERE c.materi_pokok_ref IS NULL OR c.materi_pokok_ref = ""
RETURN c.name AS Konsep, c.description AS Deskripsi
LIMIT 50

reports.title: ConceptTarget Usage (Unresolved References)
reports.query:
MATCH (t:ConceptTarget)
RETURN t.name AS TargetName, count{(t)<-[:MENDEFINISIKAN|MENYEBABKAN|MEMUNGKINKAN|MENGATUR|BAGIAN_DARI|TERDIRI_DARI|BERGANTUNG_PADA|BERINTERAKSI_DENGAN|BEREAKSI_DENGAN|MENGHASILKAN|MEMPENGARUHI|DIFORMULASIKAN_SEBAGAI]-()} AS ReferenceCount
ORDER BY ReferenceCount DESC
LIMIT 30

reports.title: Validation Coverage by Chapter
reports.query:
MATCH (ch:Chapter)-[:HAS_SUBTOPIC]->(:Subtopic)-[:HAS_CONCEPT]->(c:Concept)
WITH ch.name AS Chapter, count(c) AS TotalKonsep,
     sum(CASE WHEN c.glossary_validated = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Tervalidasi
RETURN Chapter, TotalKonsep, Tervalidasi,
       toFloat(Tervalidasi) / TotalKonsep AS ValidationRate
ORDER BY ValidationRate DESC
